snippets.title: Zara Zhang on tools
snippets.takeaway: So many people speak of startup as if their fates are predestined: X idea will never work out; the market for Y is too niche... But startups' fates are MADE, not predetermined.
snippets.summary: Zara Zhang (zarazhangrui on X) shared 1 recent update. So many people speak of startup as if their fates are predestined: X idea will never work out; the market for Y is too niche... But startups' fates are MADE, not predetermined. Given one idea, there are 1000 ways to execute it, 100 people will have 100 different approaches. Brilliant people with brilliant execution often create something when there was nothing, or make the impossible seem obvious in hindsight.
